legacyClaims.description: Add, subtract, and compare fractions and decimals

lexicalLeads.text: Add, subtract, multiply and divide decimal.
Use set builder notation to describe sets.
Use the power of set method to determine numbers of sets.

proposedObjectiveRelationships.note: MOE Grade 6 lists rounding decimals to tenths, hundredths and thousandths, which depends on decimal place value. Proposed as the supporting objective; not an explicit MOE objective by itself.
Comparing decimals is not listed for Grade 6; it is the legacy lesson's second objective and is needed for rounding. A curriculum owner decides whether it is foundation or LiberiaLearn mastery.
